items.desc: DR Congo President Félix Tshisekedi paved the way for a constitutional amendment on November 10 by signing a law authorising a referendum. The move comes amid concerns that he could seek a third term in office, with opposition figures accusing him of manoeuvring to remain in power.

items.title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient, 42-day countdown to 'Ebola-free' begins
items.desc: Kenya has discharged its last Ebola patient, who has now officially recovered. The 11 other people who had been in quarantine were also released from hospital on Wednesday, November 11, as the country began a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free. FRANCE 24's Nairobi correspondent Bastien Renouil reports.

items.title: Germany news: Police raid chapters of Gremium MC biker gang
items.desc: Police in southwestern Germany launched major early-morning operations against a biker gang. The state of Baden-Württemberg is outlawing three of its chapters. Meanwhile, unions are planning more strikes.
